Based on the provided authoritative legal context for Financial Year 2024-25, here is the legal analysis regarding the availability of the standard deduction under Section 16(ia) for salaried employees:

**1. General Availability and Statutory Basis**
The standard deduction is a statutory deduction available to salaried employees under Section 16(ia) of the Income-tax Act, 1961 [C3]. This deduction is required to be entered in the Income Tax Return (ITR) under the specific field designated for "Standard Deduction u/s 16(ia)" [C5]. The amount admissible is typically as per Part B of Form 16 [C5].

**2. Applicability Under the New Tax Regime (Section 115BAC)**
The standard deduction is available to taxpayers opting for the **New Tax Regime** (under Section 115BAC), subject to specific caps:
*   **Cap on Deduction:** For the New Tax Regime, an employee can claim the standard deduction under Section 16(ia) only to the extent of **Rs. 75,000** [C2].
*   **Comparison with Old Regime:** While the New Regime allows this deduction, other specific deductions under Section 16 are restricted. Specifically, Entertainment Allowance under Section 16(ii) and Professional Tax under Section 16(iii) **cannot** be claimed if the New Tax Regime is selected [C7].

**3. Applicability Under the Old Tax Regime**
*   **Entertainment Allowance:** If the taxpayer opts for the **Old Tax Regime**, the Entertainment Allowance under Section 16(ii) is allowed to the extent of Rs. 5,000 or 1/5th of the Basic Salary, whichever is lower [C4].
*   **Professional Tax:** Under the Old Tax Regime, Professional Tax under Section 16(iii) is allowed only to the extent of Rs. 5,000 [C4].
*   **Standard Deduction:** The context confirms that the standard deduction is a component of the salary deductions under Section 16, which applies generally, but the specific cap of Rs. 75,000 is explicitly linked to the New Tax Regime in the provided validation rules [C2].

**4. Reporting Requirements**
*   **Form 16:** The standard deduction is reported in Part B of Form 16 [C1], [C5].
*   **ITR Validation:** When filing ITR-1, ITR-2, or ITR-3, the taxpayer must ensure that the sum of the dropdowns in Schedule Salary matches the individual dropdowns, including the standard deduction [C8].

**Summary Table: Deductions under Section 16 for Salaried Individuals (FY 2024-25)**

| Deduction | Section | New Regime (115BAC) | Old Regime |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Standard Deduction** | 16(ia) | **Available** (Max Rs. 75,000) [C2] | **Available** [C3], [C5] |
| **Entertainment Allowance** | 16(ii) | **Not Available** [C7] | Available (Rs. 5,000 or 1/5th Basic, lower) [C4] |
| **Professional Tax** | 16(iii) | **Not Available** [C7] | Available (Max Rs. 5,000) [C4] |
